document_title.description: Name of the form/document as submitted (observed source key `form_title`).

document_type.description: Class of compliance document (SWMS / ITP / inspection / diary).

expires_at.description: Document/credential expiry, where the document has one.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source submission, shelf-qualified as `compliance_documents:<id>`.

financial_period.description: The period the submission falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

occurred_at.description: Submission date/time; the evidence and retention clock.

project.description: Project the compliance document is attached to.

source_refs.description: The originating system's own identifiers (`assignar_project_id`, `assignar_worker_id`, `assignar_asset_id`) kept for reconciliation, rather than freezing one vendor's column names into the contract.

status_code.description: Document status/suitability, stored **with the code set it comes from**.

summary.description: Composed prose description of the submission.
